full_details: The call was the only one of the week. He gave you a river like an arm, a stone playing-place bigger than any in London, tombs in the open street, Mantua a day's ride, and young men with swords in the heat. My lord is with the court. He did not reply, and you did not invent a reply. The tables hold three notes. In the afternoon you played Titus. The journal does not hold the playing. At home you did not write Mab, and you did not write a coast. The moon is full. Supper with Nashe is written for Sunday, and Sunday is not this week.
one_sentence: You asked Florio for Verona, wrote three notes, played Titus, and at the full moon said the town was inland.
title: Asked Florio for Verona
